{"meta":{"from":0,"size":16,"total":8},"body":[{"popularity":15,"name":"The New York Times named one dish from this Washington, D.C. restaurant among the best dishes of 2024","image_id":106217683,"page_view_counts":[{"id":"hours_6","value":0},{"id":"hours_12","value":0},{"id":"hours_24","value":0},{"id":"days_7","value":8}],"secondary_category_name":"restaurants (blog posts)","indexed_at":"2026-11-21T03:54:48.264Z","web_url":"https://www.timeout.com/washington-dc/news/the-new-york-times-named-one-dish-from-this-washington-d-c-restaurant-among-the-best-dishes-of-2024-122024","category_representation":"Restaurants","uid":"Content-Post-162439","secondary_category_representation":"Eating","type":"post","updated_at":"2024-12-20T16:38:19.000Z","indexed_annotation":"The food desk at The New York Times is a powerhouse when it comes to reporting on culinary world happenings and crafting great recipes, so it's worth a look when they make a best of the year list. The team outlined the 26 best dishes they ate at U.S. restaurants in 2024, and one dish from a Washington, D.C. restaurant made the cut. 

RECOMMENDED: The New York Times named these Washington, D.C., restaurants two of the best in America
The dish in question? Bò lá lốt from Moon Rabbit, decorated chef Kevin Tien's inventive Vietnamese restaurant in Penn Quarter. Tien serves the well-known Vietnamese street food with "a dipping sauce of labneh crowned with lemongrass-chile crunch, a nod to his love for dolmas," Times writer Brett Anderson writes. "A similar swirl of influences animates all of the food at Moon Rabbit. "But this dish of juicy grilled beef wrapped in perilla leaves is one of the only items you can plan to find on the always-evolving menu." Good news for those who want to try it, because Tien told the Times he doesn't expect this dish to leave the ever-changing menu since it's so beloved.
The list includes 26 dishes from restaurants around the country that Times staffers tried in 2024. Other dishes on the list include fried chicken from Idaho, green garlic and clam pasta from Rhode Island, a pie filled with toasted honey custard from San Francisco, and a stacked ham sandwich from Detroit. The team also created a separate list of the best dishes they ate in New York in 2024. Check out the full list below, and here. 
The 26 best dishes The New York Times food staff ate in the U.S. in 2024:

Molotes de Plátano at Komal in Los Angeles
Tonnarelli With Green Garlic and Narragansett Clams at Giusto in Newport, R.I.
Suadero Taco at Paprika at Austin in Texas
Ham Sandwich at Mike’s Famous Ham Place in Detroit
French Onion Soup at Little Sparrow in Atlanta
Foieberry at Lazy Betty in Atlanta
Birria at Birrieria Ocotlan in Chicago
Fried Chicken at Stanley Supper Club in Stanley, Idaho
Bò Lá Lốt at Moon Rabbit in Washington, D.C.
Corn Mash at the Lobbyist in Memphis, Tenn.
Chochoyotes at Acamaya in New Orleans
Trúng Và Trúng at Sap Sua in Denver
Arroz Caldo at Kultura in Charleston, S.C.
Horchata Berlinesa at Ema in Houston
Burnt Honey Pie at Grand Opening in San Francisco
Goat Chops at Aga’s in Houston
Lamb Posole at Paloma in Santa Fe, N.M.
Tuna de Tigre at Mr. Tuna in Portland, Maine
Mushroom Breakfast Taco at Ocotillo in Portland, Maine
Croissubi at Bake Sum in Oakland, Calif.
Pierogi z Dynia at Little Walter’s in Philadelphia
Cherries Jubilee Sundae at Sugarpine Drive-In in Troutdale, Ore.
Mussels With ’Nduja Butter at Heavenly Creatures in Portland, Ore.
Beef Empanadas at the Port of Call in Mystic, Conn.
Lebanese Sundae at Leila in Detroit
Mozzarella Sandwich at Bread Head in Los Angeles","published_at_utc":"2024-12-20T16:38:19.000Z","category_name":"restaurants (category)","image_url":"https://media.timeout.com/images/106217683/image.jpg"},{"popularity":2,"name":"Massive Lego art exhibition The Art of the Brick will come to Washington, D.C. in January 2025","image_id":10
